name: com.lib.loopsdk.ui.feature_spin_the_wheel.spin_wheel_list.SpinWheelListActivity
description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen when a user selects the wheel-of-fortune game from the loyalty home. It lists available and unlocked wheels and lets the user choose one to unlock or play.
disableEffect: Users cannot browse or start Loop Loyalty wheel-of-fortune games.
